assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-50.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's condition.
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness is coded as R42.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded as I25.10.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
There is an order document ("as stated in the order") for the mobile cardiac telemetry.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to the symptomatic episodes.
The denial was a medical necessity determination.
The denial applies to this specific episode of care.
